That gap is too large to leave unaddressed and suggests either (a) different electronic states/units, (b) aTB run mismatch, or (c) a strongly different emissive state in aggregate. This should materially reduce confidence unless reconciled.
3) The torsion argument is directionally reasonable (tiny Δdihedral), but the writeup simultaneously frames torsion as “mid vs neighbors” (E21) while the absolute value is ~0.10° (E21/E31) and the policy thresholds for meaningful torsion are 8–15°; this can mislead readers into thinking torsion is mechanistically plausible when it is effectively absent.
